question: Among female outpatients with abnormally high uric acid levels (above the normal female threshold), identify those whose lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) is at least 200 units above the upper limit of normal. For each such patient, return their ID, sex, date of birth, age at the time of the laboratory test, and a classification of their alkaline phosphatase (ALP) as 'normal' or 'abNormal'. Only include patients whose laboratory records have a valid (non-null) ALP value.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  P."XCL_058" AS ID,
  P."XCL_059" AS sex,
  P."XCL_060" AS date_of_birth,
  L."XCL_016" AS age_at_test,
  CASE
    WHEN L."XCL_048" BETWEEN 40 AND 120 THEN 'normal'
    ELSE 'abNormal'
  END AS ALP_classification
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L
  ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND L."XCL_022" > 6.5
  AND L."XCL_018" >= 250 + 200
  AND L."XCL_048" IS NOT NULL

For each such patient, return their ID, sex, date of birth, age at the time of the laboratory test, and a classification of their alkaline phosphatase (ALP) as 'normal' or 'abNormal'. Only include patients whose laboratory records have a valid (non-null) ALP value.
